purpose: Pre-sign security checkpoint and proof-carrying payment research for NEAR agent payments

audit_target.documentation_and_workflow_updates: Documentation and CI-trigger updates were committed after the implementation snapshot; inspect the current PR head for the latest documentation.

architecture_layers.role: AI/agent proposes a payment intent; proposal is untrusted input
Main application gathers NEAR evidence and evaluates deterministic policy; incomplete evidence must not be treated as safe
Wallet owner approves exact receiver and amount through existing wallet approval flow
Ed25519 signed assessment integrity at isolated signer boundary; signature authenticity does not replace signer-side policy checks
authorizeSignedPreflight() re-evaluates decision, status, risk score, receiver, amount, allowlist, network, kill switch and payment cap before reservation; not deployed from this branch
Canonical SHA-256 commitment binds network/chain, actor, wallet, receiver, exact amount, nonce, expiry, policy hash and approval ID

NEAR Rust contract requires Ed25519 proof envelope; binds chain, contract, caller, receiver, amount, approval, nonce, validity window, intent hash, provenance root, evidence snapshot, policy version and key version; enforces replay, expiry, per-payment and daily caps
Production Main Worker and Signer Worker do not construct and submit the new contract proof envelope
No fresh deployment, proof-key installation, live proof payment or final receipt verification is claimed
No hardware TEE remote-attestation verifier is claimed

proof_layers_must_not_be_conflated: PCPI SHA-256 intent commitment in PR #36 is not the Ed25519 contract proof envelope in PR #42.
authorizeSignedPreflight() is signer-side policy re-evaluation on the lab branch; it is not PCPI commitment verification.
The JavaScript contract-envelope helper is a reference/test signer, not the production private-key custody service.
The Rust contract verifies the configured proof signer's signature and bound context; it does not independently fetch or authenticate external evidence.
The proof-carrying contract is not the current production payment path.

historical_local_run.scope: Historical local evidence for the exact tested commits above; not evidence that current PR head ed86e0f was rerun.
